name: Plasma
description: Full-container WebGL2 raymarched plasma volume with twisting, waving glowing ribbons in a single tint, soft film grain and an optional pointer-driven orbit and glow.
contents: Container div with a single absolutely positioned WebGL canvas filling it
behavior: Raymarches a twisting plasma volume in a low-resolution pass, then composites it to the canvas with tone mapping and grain
Fades in over about 1.6 seconds on mount when intro is on
Pointer position over the window orbits the view slightly and adds a soft glow near the cursor
Time can run forward, reverse or ping-pong
Pauses rendering when offscreen or the tab is hidden, and idles when nothing is moving
Light mode draws dark ink on transparent for light backgrounds
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing motion, intro and pointer reaction
editableByProps: Plasma color, brightness, shine, softness and grain
Animation speed, direction, twist, wave amount, zoom scale and paused state
Render quality and device pixel ratio
Mouse interaction and intro on or off
Edge fade, overall opacity and light mode for light backgrounds
Container size and extra classes through className, other attributes through rest props

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the plasma shape or ribbon structure
needsCodeEdit.where: VOLUME shader string, the raymarch loop in main
goalYaw and goalPitch lines in the frame function

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the pixel budget for large containers

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable or shaders fail to compile
Fills its parent: needs a parent with a defined height since the root is h-full w-full
Listens to pointer movement on the whole window, not only the container
Heavy GPU raymarching (60 steps per pixel), may be slow on low-end mobile; lower quality for small screens
Device pixel ratio is capped at 2
Color is set at the tint level only, the highlight is derived automatically
Uses 'use client' and a canvas with aria-hidden, purely decorative
